notes.title: Modifiers Update (Patch 1.5)
notes.content:
[h1]Modifiers[/h1]

Spice up a playthrough with an assortment of game modifications.
Modifications can only be changed on a fresh save file, and will lock in once the player has left the start room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40303552/b29486d39b98b13a3d154ed60b64eb5d37833c9c.png[/img]

[h2]New Game Plus[/h2]

Start the game with all the base game abilities unlocked.
The first three bosses can be fought in any order before accessing the trash zone.
Does not unlock any upgrades.

[h2]Random Enemies[/h2]

Enemies will be replaced by another random enemy.
Enemy population will change each time you revisit a room.

[h2]Immortal Enemies[/h2]

Enemies cannot die.
They will still be stunned by damage.

[h2]Broken Doors[/h2]

Door panels no longer function, and will not open doors.

[h2]Trash Collector[/h2]

Each enemy must be destroyed before the final boss can be attempted.
Enemies will respawn after being killed, but will not change the counter if destroyed again.

[h3]Notes[/h3]

Any modifiers will disable leaderboards.
New Game Plus will disable achievements.
All modifiers are intended for use in the base game, however some will continue to be active when travelling to the Salvation.
Immortal Enemies and Trash Collector can be active at the same time, the enemy will count towards the total once it has been dealt the amount of damage that would normally destroy it.


[h1]Tweaks[/h1]

A black background has been added to the menu to improve visibility.

High clarity explosion visuals can be selected from the menu.

Bullets can now be fired with the right trigger, as well as the bumper.

Mild clarity improvements for leaderboards.


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Fixed a bug that allowed the player to clip into the edge of narrow ground segments.

Covered up a few remaining visible seems between zones.

Prevent menu indicator colour disappearing when selecting a non-selectable menu item.

notes.title: Salvation Update (Patch 1.4)
notes.content:
Once you've explored all there is to explore on the space station Deliverance, why not zip over to its sister ship The Salvation.

The Salvation update includes:
- A whole new space ship to explore.
- Two new abilities
- Three new bosses
- Three extra upgrades
- A boss rush
- A hard mode version of all new and existing bosses

[previewyoutube=wFThttlyBis;full][/previewyoutube]

The Salvation update is available for no extra charge for existing owners of Trash Quest. I will probably be increasing the price of the base game by a dollar or two to account for the extra content, but I'll give people a little bit of a grace period to get it at the current price.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Heyo, I've got stats and achievements for ya.


Stats:

Added a bunch of stats, replaces the speedrun timer menu option. Each stat can be toggled on or off independently.


Achievements:

With the revamp to the stats, a number of new achievements are possible. New achievements are for low grounded time, low energy usage, low damage taken, as well as a speedrun achievement with a shorter time requirement and an achievement that combines pacifist and hitless.


Fixes/Tweaks:

Fixed a number issue with the position resets.
Added a slightly wider spotlight mode.
Added jump input buffering during room transitions.
Tiny increase in spike jump window.



Thanks as always,
Frank

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
1.2 is dead. Long live 1.2.

Some more changes, but most of it is parallel to the changes in 1.2 so this one is just a minor version number bump. Has the changes that probably should have been in 1.2.
(dot points at bottom)


Speedrun changes:

100% completion no longer counts doors. This affects the 100% achievement and leaderboard. The requirements as of this patch for 100% is all 4 bosses and all 14 trinkets (5 abilities, 9 upgrades).
Practice mode now will save your health state when setting a quick spawn point, and if you want to alter your health you can do that by holding H while pressing a number key.


QoL Changes:

Slightly altered the draw order of the map so the player icon will be above all other icons other than those informing you you don't have the required ability.
Press ESC (or whatever button you use to bring up the menu) to skip the intro scene.
Press Numpad Plus to fullscreen. (should work during intro scene)


As always, I'd love to hear any feedback you have. I'm watching the forums here and the discord server http://discord.gg/SyEKQmT
Why not join and see the wild ways these rascals are breaking my game for the sake of a few seconds.

Peace,
Frank

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Hey all.
Welcome to the Speedrun QoL patch.
(dot points at bottom)


Speedrun Changes:

Two new buttons have been added that provide a shortcut for some menuing or Alt-F4ing.
Respawn will teleport you to the starting room and Reset will wipe your current save file and reload it.
Neither of these will prevent you from setting leaderboard times or gaining achievements.

Speedrun practice mode contains a number of features, but activating it will lock that save file out from setting leaderboard times and gaining achievements until the save file is reset.
Features of practice mode include modifying the timescale, setting quick spawn points and quick killing bosses.


Balance Changes:

Some bosses will be easier and some will be harder. The Twins have slightly more health. The Babysitter has less health and slightly altered attack patterns that should be less luck reliant to avoid. The Gatekeeper has had all of its attacks made slightly tougher.
Some level geometry and enemy positions have been altered.


Bug Fixes:

Visual bug preventing the start zone from having the right colour when the a save file is loaded has been fixed.
Since dropping native PS4 controller support in patch 1.1, there is no conflict between Xbox and PS4 dpad axis names, so dpad support for xbox controllers has been added. This will hopefully mean a nicer experience for users of PS4 mapping software.
Added some checks to the per-room respawn system. A back up spawn position will be saved when you enter the room, and if the regular spawn point is found to be unsafe, it will fallback to the back up. Unsafeness is determined by time between room load and death, between regular respawn set and death, and between respawn time and death. It won't catch all cases, but I'm trying to find a solution that works for both speedrunners (who have already started speculating about uses for respawn point manipulation) and casual players. Hopefully this will work for the highest number of people.


This one is a much bigger patch than I was originally planning, so there is the potential for some bugs falling through the cracks. If you encounter any issues (or just have any thoughts on the speedrun/balance changes) I'm trying to keep a close eye on the discussions here, or alternately come talk to me/other players here: discord.gg/SyEKQmT

Thanks again for playing, hope y'all have fun.
Frank

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
As with any release day for a solo/small dev team, today has been full of highs and lows, and with no shortage of fires to put out.

The biggest issue seems to be that the hover was not always responding to inputs. I had a lot of trouble reproducing this locally, until I found a very small edge case involving doing a hover but not letting go of the button then moving into a different room and letting go of the button before the transition completes.  Theta (absolute legend) suggested that this might also occur if the button is released during a death transition and this does indeed appear to be the case, and I believe this is likely the cause of most of the reported hover issues. This issue has been fixed and the hover code has been made a touch more robust.

The other big thing I was hearing was issues using PS4 controllers. I had put native support for PS4 controllers into the game, but it seemed that this was conflicting with Steam's input mapping. For now, I've removed my PS4 input handling and will be letting Steam take care of it. I believe this will work better for more people.

Also some smaller fixes. A thicker border around the menu text, better placement of the credit text, and fixed an issue where the game thinks that crates are enemies, causing some achievements to not be attainable.

Thanks to those who have already played it, those who've brought these issue to my awareness, and those who will do so in the future.

Peace,
Frank
